evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/07-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: Hills, meadows, valleys, sea, rivers or trees rejoice, clap or sing before God (weight 5.3). Pair score 5.3.

Only in Psalm 98, new song; rivers clap their hands: Trumpets and shofar sounded before the King YHWH; Rivers clap their hands and mountains sing together before YHWH; God comes to judge the earth with righteousness, and all creation rejoices; All the earth or all peoples are summoned to shout and sing to God; Call to sing a new song (shir hadash) to God.

Only in Al-Rahman: the Merciful taught the Quran; sun and moon by reckoning; clay and smokeless fire; the two seas and the barrier: God raised the sky and set the Balance: do not transgress in the balance; weigh with justice and do not skimp; Lord of the two easts and the two wests (the solstitial sunrises and sunsets); The Merciful (al-Rahman) taught the Quran, created man and taught him clear speech (bayan); From the two seas come pearls and coral (marjan); A creation litany with a refrain after every line [divergence between the texts]; The text addresses jinn and humans together in the dual ('you two', al-thaqalan, 'the two weighty ones'); All in heaven and earth ask of him; every day he is engaged in some affair (kull yawm huwa fi sha'n); Earth and heavens will perish and wear out like a garment, changed like clothing, but God remains the same; Man created from ringing clay like pottery, the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire (marij min nar); Just weights and measures, and the ground given for them [divergence between the texts]; Refrain repeated 31 times: 'Which then of the bounties of your Lord will you two (jinn and humans) deny?'; Ships running on the sea like landmarks/mountains are a sign; God could still the wind and leave them motionless or wreck them; and 9 more.
